description: This is a shell script that defines functions and variables related to firmware upgrade procedures for various hardware devices. It includes device-specific setup functions, upgrade steps, and configuration copying routines, serving as a platform-specific upgrade library in an embedded Linux environment.

methods.name: xiaomi_initramfs_prepare
methods.description: Prepares the initramfs for Xiaomi devices by formatting relevant MTD partitions if root filesystem is tmpfs.

methods.name: asus_initial_setup
methods.description: Removes existing Linux and JFFS2 volumes on initramfs devices.

methods.name: remove_oem_ubi_volume
methods.description: Removes specified OEM UBI volume if it exists.

methods.name: tplink_get_boot_part
methods.description: Determines the current boot partition based on kernel command line or U-boot environment.

methods.name: tplink_do_upgrade
methods.description: Performs a firmware upgrade on TP-Link devices, handling boot partition toggling and OEM volume removal.

methods.name: platform_check_image
methods.description: Stub function that always returns success, probably for image validation.

methods.name: platform_pre_upgrade
methods.description: Performs device-specific preparations before upgrading based on the board name.

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade
methods.description: Dispatches the upgrade process for various device models, with device-specific logic.

methods.name: platform_copy_config
methods.description: Copies configuration to specific devices after upgrade.
